description: Ministry of Defence - The name list of the Air Force Personnel approved the award of the Armed Services Long Service Medal and Clasp
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the award of the Sri Lanka Armed Services Long Service Medal to military personnel (specifically airmen) for completing 12 years of service. This falls under public sector service conditions and benefits, specifically relating to military service awards and recognition, which is categorized under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8). While it involves named individuals, it does not concern government structural changes, ministerial appointments, or portfolio responsibilities (which would fall under Types 1-3), but rather administrative recognition of long service in the armed forces.
